Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Is it possible to cancle the votes in the priscii sub-referendum with :

- Quentin : Sabbat Bishop: Once each political action, Quentin may burn 1
blood to cancel the votes of any vampire.

- Telepathic Vote Counting : [AUS] Only usable during a referendum. A
vampire of your choice abstains from voting. This can cancel that vampire's
votes.

- Demonstration : Unique Master. Tap to cancel the votes of any vampire
during a political action.

- Kindred Manipulation : Only usable during a referendum. Change the votes
of a younger vampire to votes of your choice.

??

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
>
> Is it possible to cancle the votes in the priscii sub-referendum with :

Yes. If the vampire's votes are cancelled (or changed), all of his
votes are changed - both in the sub-referendum and in the main.

> - Quentin : Sabbat Bishop: Once each political action, Quentin may burn 1
> blood to cancel the votes of any vampire.

Yes.

> - Telepathic Vote Counting : [AUS] Only usable during a referendum. A
> vampire of your choice abstains from voting. This can cancel that vampire's
> votes.

Yes.

> - Demonstration : Unique Master. Tap to cancel the votes of any vampire
> during a political action.

Yes.

> - Kindred Manipulation : Only usable during a referendum. Change the votes
> of a younger vampire to votes of your choice.

Yes.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Raille" asked:

> Can you toss a political card for a vote in the Prisci sub-referendum?

No.

6.3.3 Gaining Votes

"Each ready priscus provides one vote for this sub-referendum,
and no other votes may be used in this sub-referendum."

Carpe noctem.
